user.title: Connect Cozify account
user.description: Enter the email address of your Cozify account. A one-time code will be sent to it.

code.title: Enter the code
code.description: Enter the one-time code sent to {email}.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Cozify credentials for {email} expired. A new one-time code will be sent.

error.invalid_code: The code was not accepted. Codes are single use; request a new one.

abort.no_hubs: No additional hubs found for this account.
abort.remote_unavailable: Remote access is not enabled for this hub and it was not found on the local network.

init.title: Connection
init.description: Home Assistant uses the local network when the hub is reachable and falls back to the Cozify cloud relay.

run_scene.name: Run scene
run_scene.description: Turn a hub scene on or off.

set_rule_state.name: Set rule state
set_rule_state.description: Enable or disable a hub rule.

delete_rule.name: Delete rule
delete_rule.description: Delete a rule instance from the hub.

deploy_custom_rule.name: Deploy custom rule
deploy_custom_rule.description: Install or upgrade a Python custom rule on the hub. Existing instances are recreated with their settings.

file.name: File
file.description: Path to a .py file (must be in allowlist_external_dirs).

get_rule_log.name: Get rule log
get_rule_log.description: Read the hub rule log (UTC times).

get_rule_proposals.name: Get rule proposals
get_rule_proposals.description: Ask the hub which rules it suggests for devices.

create_rule_from_proposal.name: Create rule from proposal
create_rule_from_proposal.description: Create a hub rule from a proposal returned by get_rule_proposals.

suggest_workload_split.name: Suggest workload split
suggest_workload_split.description: Analyse automations and recommend which should run on the hub, in Home Assistant, or split.

send_command.name: Send raw command
send_command.description: Send raw device commands as documented in the Cozify API (PUT /devices/command).
